messages:
maria_cs: Ironforge Logistics submitted an onboarding request. Scope: compact multimodal parser (~7B) for on-prem. Needs OCR from photos, structured manifest parsing, PII redaction at edge, hazmat detection, KMS/HSM for keys, and 90d audit logs. They want an eval + rollout proposal before renewal (about 6 weeks). Can ENG + SE triage?

dan_runtime: Looping in runtime. Quick Q: what's their latency SLO and infra (GPU types, memory)? q4_0 quant looks likely but we need numbers to size KV cache and batchers.

leah_se: I'll request the intake checklist and ask for 200 sample manifests and 100 smartphone photos. I'll prepare an enablement deck and runbook.

maria_cs: Two non-negotiables from the customer: hazmat recall >= 0.95, and zero PII leakage outside their network (redaction must occur before any telemetry leaves).

dan_runtime: HSM: we need their PKCS#11 endpoint and test creds for initial integration. For models, propose two variants: rwd-7b-q4 (low-latency) and rwd-7b-q2 (cost-optimized). Expected p95 text-only <120ms, OCR flows allowed up to ~600ms.

leah_se: Draft eval plan: 5k labeled examples (entities + hazmat labels + photos). Metrics: entity precision/recall/F1, hazmat recall, redaction success rate, p95 latency. Canary: 10% traffic for 7 days, rollback on hazmat recall <0.93 or PII leakage incidents. I will own the harness and dashboard. Example run: 

```
python eval_harness.py --model rwd-7b-q4 --data ironforge_samples.jsonl --metrics recall,precision,f1,latency --out ironforge_report.json
```

maria_cs: Renewal note: customer flagged as "watch" if we don't meet their timeline. I'll coordinate escalation to AE for timeline slippage.

dan_runtime: I'll post infra estimate + cost uplift later today. Potential blockers: HSM integration delays or if their GPUs are older (we may need to propose Dedicated on our side).

leah_se: Scheduling: intake + samples by Thu, initial eval run 10 business days after samples, canary 1 week post-eval. Booking cross-functional sync for Tue.

ops_bot: Created checklist: [Intake form sent] [Samples requested] [HSM details requested] [Eval harness assigned] [Canary plan scheduled]. Will ping @maria_cs on updates.

maria_cs: Thanks. Also we'll collect feedback during enablement with a short survey and shared issue tracker. Add renewal risk to account health. :thumbsup:

leah_se: Will draft enablement slides and the post-enablement survey.

dan_runtime: Posting resource estimates in thread shortly. Call out any infra gaps that would delay delivery.

maria_cs: Add any risks here so I can keep AE informed.
